posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
DWNM's incap does NOT show Skinwalker Gloomy.  We don't know that original Gloomy even has a tail; it might be a side effect of his embodiment in flesh, that his spirit-snake familiar could only come with him by attaching her face to his butt (which is after all where every dark overlord wants his faithful servant to be).

Interesting side-note...the RCIR box shows faces on all four sides, as with the EE box...two of those sides show Fixer and Nightmist, the two heroes who aren't on the top of the box, and a third shows a woman who I presume is the Operative.  But the fourth shows someone we've never seen before - a green-scaled snake.  I'm assuming this is Ophidia, but we can't see her head on Skinwalker, and she isn't green on her own card, so this is the only place we can see her looking like this.  And it happens to be far and away my favorite of the four pictures.  Like, if I had a shelf to put SOTM on, I'd rotate the box every time I put it away, to make sure that picture was showing out.
